title: OpsToolbox: Dry‑Run Sandbox and Composable Runlet Library
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an interactive dry‑run sandbox and a small composable runlet library (OpsToolbox) that lets oncall and SREs author, preview, and safely execute runbook steps as idempotent tasks. Focus is on: 1) deterministic dry runs against replayed telemetry, 2) a lightweight JS/TS runlet SDK with explicit safety gates, and 3) a CLI + Console preview that surfaces side effects, required permissions, and an automatic rollback plan.
acceptance_criteria: Dry‑run harness can replay 1 hour of real telemetry captured from an incident and show a step‑by‑step simulated outcome without mutating production resources
Runlet library exposes composable primitives (check, read, mutate) with explicit permission scopes and an opt‑in unsafe flag
CLI command `opsbox preview <runlet>` opens a structured preview that includes expected API calls, affected resources, and estimated latency/cost
Console preview integrates a single-step simulator for runlets and a visualize button for step dependencies
Unit and integration tests for runlets + dry‑run harness with 80% coverage for critical primitives
Security review checklist completed and KMS keys usage documented for any sensitive parameter handling
